{"CommandLine":"ssh colab "cat << 'EOF' > /content/build_qe_gpu_serial.sh
#!/bin/bash
if [ ! -d /opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk ]; then
    echo 'Installing NVHPC...'
    wget -q http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/universe/n/ncurses/libtinfo5_6.3-2_amd64.deb
    wget -q http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/universe/n/ncurses/libncursesw5_6.3-2_amd64.deb
    dpkg -i libtinfo5_6.3-2_amd64.deb libncursesw5_6.3-2_amd64.deb
    curl -s -L https://developer.download.nvidia.com/hpc-sdk/ubuntu/DEB-GPG-KEY-NVIDIA-HPC-SDK | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-hpc-sdk-archive-keyring.gpg
    echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-hpc-sdk-archive-keyring.gpg] https://developer.download.nvidia.com/hpc-sdk/ubuntu/amd64 /' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvhpc.list
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y nvhpc-23-11
fi

echo 'Cloning Quantum ESPRESSO...'
cd /content
if [ ! -d q-e ]; then
    git clone -b qe-7.2 https://gitlab.com/QEF/q-e.git
fi
cd q-e
mkdir -p build_gpu_serial
cd build_gpu_serial

echo 'Configuring and building Quantum ESPRESSO (Serial GPU, no MPI)...'
export NVHPC_HOME=/opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/23.11
export PATH=\$NVHPC_HOME/compilers/bin:\$NVHPC_HOME/cuda/bin:\$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=\$NVHPC_HOME/compilers/lib:\$NVHPC_HOME/math_libs/lib64:\$NVHPC_HOME/cuda/lib64:/usr/local/cuda/lib64:/usr/lib64-nvidia:\$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=nvc -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=nvfortran -DQE_ENABLE_MPI=OFF -DQE_ENABLE_OPENACC=ON -DQE_ENABLE_CUDA=ON -DNVFORTRAN_CUDA_CC=75 -DQE_FFTW_VENDOR=Internal
make pw -j4

mkdir -p /content/bin
cp bin/pw.x /content/bin/pw.x.serial
echo 'Build complete: /content/bin/pw.x.serial'
EOF
nohup bash /content/build_qe_gpu_serial.sh > /content/build.log 2>&1 &"","Cwd":"/home/yamazaki_yuta","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Running command","toolSummary":"Build QE on Colab"}
